reason: brief P2j. hue and chroma of a custom illuminant are interface-only on desktop: _illum_xy_callback (src/iop/channelmixerrgb.c) turns them into the illuminant's x, y (dt_Lch_to_xyY at L 100 around D50) and its temperature (xy_to_CCT, below 3000 K CCT_reverse_lookup); gui_changed shows them back from x, y (dt_xyY_to_Lch; the hue only above chroma 0). app/schema Formulas.IlluminantHueChroma repeats both directions. The area mapping and colour checker controls wait for the colour picker and the chart tool.
